title: Capacity soak + burst autoscale validation for Dedicated pools
creator: Ava Patel
description: Goal: Validate Dedicated capacity autoscaling behavior under combined burst + steady-state traffic patterns and confirm regression-free throughput (tokens/sec) and latency (p95) compared to the baseline. We need: 1) a reproducible soak harness that runs nightly against a representative 4-GPU Dedicated pool image, 2) deterministic burst generator for short high-QPS spikes, 3) steady-state long-run generator for 4+ hours to exercise caching and scheduling, and 4) alerting rules that detect >=10% regression in tokens/sec or >=20% regression in p95. This ticket covers test design, implementation, and first-pass execution with follow-up tuning of autoscaler policies.
test_plan:
Scenarios: 
- Burst: 90s spike to 3x nominal tokens/sec (simulate marketing-driven traffic) with 95th percentile p95 target < 250ms above nominal p95; verify no failed requests and autoscaler triggers only after configured stabilization window.
- Steady-state soak: 4-hour run at 70% of pool capacity (tokens/sec) to surface memory growth, KV cache warm/cold dynamics, and scheduler jitter; track p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec; baseline regression detection relative to baseline run.
- Mixed: 1-hour alternating pattern (10min steady, 2min burst) to validate scale-up/scale-down hysteresis and cost delta.
Metrics to capture: tokens/sec (aggregate + per-instance), p50/p95/p99 latency, rate of 5xx errors, cold-start frequency, KV cache hit ratio, GPU utilization.
Pass criteria: no more than 0.1% increase in 5xx vs baseline, sustained tokens/sec within +/-10% of expected capacity during steady-state, autoscaler action within policy windows, p95 regressions flagged and triaged if >20%.
test_results: Preliminary run 2026-03-04: executed burst + 2h soak on staging 4x-GPU pool image. Observations: burst spike reached 2.9x nominal tokens/sec, autoscaler scaled up after 75s (policy: 60s stabilization + 60s cool-down) — scaling latency slightly higher than desired; p95 increased by 18% during scale events, returned to baseline after warmup; KV cache hit ratio improved 12% over first hour of soak; observed two transient 5xx errors (0.03%), correlated to a sidecar OOM in older runtime image. Actions: bump stabilization window to 45s and increase scale step from 1->2 nodes, schedule runtime sidecar image update (PR linked), add extra warmup prefix to reduce cold-cache penalty.

acceptance_criteria: Nightly harness can run headless and produce a reproducible tokens/sec + latency CSV for each scenario.
Automated regression detection flags a run if tokens/sec decreases by >=10% or p95 increases by >=20% vs baseline.
No more than 0.2% 5xx errors during steady-state soak compared to baseline; any transient errors have triage tickets.
Autoscaler policy validated: scale-up completes within configured stabilization window and scale-down respects cool-down; cost delta report generated per test run.
